posts.name: Manasan Siva
posts.cooked:
In Item DocType, there are name, item_code and item_name. I can undestand the purpose of item_name but why item_code exists, if name already serves the same purpose?

For example: DER-6078 => Nike Shoe XL, here name is DER-6078 and item_name is Nike Shoe XL. What is the purpose of duplicated item_code DER-6078 here?

posts.name: Sherin K R
posts.cooked:
In Stock Settings you can find one field named Item Naming By, where you can find. two options.

  1. Item Code
  2. Naming Series

If you are using Item Code, Item Code itself will take as document name which is name. But in case of Naming series, It will be a system generated value. In such conditions you can put your own identifier for an item in Item Code.

posts.name: Peer
posts.cooked:
You can think of:

  • name as a primary key for the database
  • item_code as some human readable/usable article number the company uses as a short form for listing/ordering articles, price lists, etc.
  • item_name as a human readable short description which can appear in invoice etc.

The behavior of these is to some extent configurable and influences what needs to be input when creating a new item, how it is displayed on the desk and also in link fields, how it is numbered, etc.

Also consider the configuration of the title in the doctype definition for these purposes.
It might need some tinkering and experimenting to understand and get it right.
